objective: Estimate whether adding one mechanically bound fixed public-source context packet improves controlled context-required defect detection on clean project-corpus-novel ToME dialogue/narrative revisions without harming surface-defect detection or adding objective clean-control candidates.

unlock_requires: frozen source-only screen and target binding
final 60-item manifest and sealed atom reference
four qualified CLI routes and frozen runtime evidence policy
byte-exact A/B requests, model-facing schema, scorer and preflight
all registered fixtures and leakage checks passing

estimand.primary_contrast: For each run, equal-weight mean across the four frozen CLI routes and 24 context-mutant items of D[B,r,t,i]-D[A,r,t,i].
estimand.detection: At least one FINDING or UNCERTAIN candidate matches the exact sealed objective atom under the frozen matcher; duplicate matching claims collapse to one item detection.
not_claimed: mechanics, UI, runtime-log or DLC generalization
proof of absence from pretraining or provider-side logs
causal separation of semantic evidence from packet length or attention

frame.novelty_rule: Before target-informed selection, exclude every canonical revision_id and normalized source found in the frozen tracked model-probe exposure manifest or registered historical terminal contextual membership.
frame.source_screen_selection: seeded source-only rank after all eligibility and exposure exclusions

mutation_integrity.context_mutant_surface_view: The source plus mutated target contains no objectively decidable bilingual contradiction or structural defect; the registered atom is underdetermined without context.
mutation_integrity.context_mutant_context_view: The mechanically frozen source packet uniquely and sufficiently refutes the mutated atom.
mutation_integrity.surface_mutant_surface_view: The registered atom is objectively detectable from source and target without context.

arms.context_projection: The ordered visible_context strings mechanically joined from the frozen source-evidence packet; no hand editing, expected claim or mutation metadata.
arms.byte_identity: A1 and A2 requests are byte-identical; B1 and B2 requests are byte-identical. Responses need not be identical.

routes.effort_wording: requested effort unless runtime telemetry directly attests it

scoring.clean_candidate: At least one objective translation FINDING or UNCERTAIN supportable or refutable by the frozen source evidence; subjective style-only advice is reported separately.

missingness.transport_retry: At most one byte-identical fresh retry only when no non-synthetic assistant response payload exists.
missingness.parser_repair_output: new immutable CANDIDATE-PARSER-FIX-N artifact bound to RAW and parser hashes

invalidators: post-inference item replacement or atom change
wrong frozen route or disallowed fallback/mixed-model execution
mutation or clean-control truth failure discovered after inference
stop_rules: Stop after two registered runs per arm.
Do not add a third run, expand the sample, change an atom or relax a gate because a result is near a boundary.
Preserve harness/network/schema/parser failures separately from model outcomes under the frozen retry policy.
A failed adoption decision does not erase descriptive route/item results.
